cases.purpose: Isolate relative symlink freeze and thaw on a disposable ext4 loop mount; verify frozen state with the reference ioctl and a blocked writer, then verify thaw and resumed writes.
cases.oracle: util-linux fsfreeze and independently checked EBUSY and writer lifecycle
cases.comparison: Each side must independently assert freeze, EBUSY, blocked writer, thaw, resumed writer and successful teardown before parity comparison.
cases.script:
export LC_ALL=C
RT=/tmp/rt; M=$RT/mnt; dev=; wp=; mounted=0
cleanup() {
  local prior=$? bad=0 i
  trap - EXIT
  if (( mounted )); then /usr/sbin/fsfreeze -u "$M" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
  if [[ -n $wp ]]; then kill "$wp" 2>/dev/null || :; wait "$wp" 2>/dev/null || :; fi
  if (( mounted )); then /usr/bin/umount "$M" || bad=1; fi
  if [[ -n $dev ]]; then
    /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$dev" || bad=1
    for ((i=0;i<50;i++)); do [[ -e /sys/block/${dev#/dev/}/loop/backing_file ]] || break; /usr/bin/sleep 0.1; done
    [[ ! -e /sys/block/${dev#/dev/}/loop/backing_file ]] || bad=1
  fi
  (( bad == 0 )) || { echo 'teardown failed' >&2; exit 98; }
  exit "$prior"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
/usr/bin/mkdir -p "$M" || exit 99
/usr/bin/truncate -s 8M "$RT/img" || exit 99
/usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4 -q -F -O ^has_journal -E nodiscard,lazy_itable_init=0 "$RT/img" || exit 99
dev=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -f --show --nooverlap "$RT/img") || exit 99
[[ $dev =~ ^/dev/loop[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 99
/usr/bin/mount "$dev" "$M" || exit 99
mounted=1
cd "$RT" || exit 99
/usr/bin/ln -s mnt lnk || exit 99
fsfreeze -f lnk || { echo 'freeze-link failed' >&2; exit 1; }
if /usr/sbin/fsfreeze -f "$M" >probe.out 2>probe.err; then
  echo 'probe unexpectedly froze filesystem' >&2; exit 1
fi
/usr/bin/grep -Fq 'Device or resource busy' probe.err || { cat probe.err >&2; exit 1; }
echo 'freeze-link=ok probe=busy'
/usr/bin/dd if=/dev/zero of="$M/w" bs=4k count=1 conv=fsync status=none & wp=$!
/usr/bin/sleep 1
kill -0 "$wp" 2>/dev/null || { echo 'writer finished before thaw' >&2; exit 1; }
echo 'writer=blocked'
fsfreeze -u lnk || { echo 'thaw-link failed' >&2; exit 1; }
wait "$wp" || { wp=; echo 'writer failed after thaw' >&2; exit 1; }
wp=
[[ $(/usr/bin/stat -c %s "$M/w") == 4096 ]] || exit 1
/usr/sbin/fsfreeze -f "$M" || exit 1
/usr/sbin/fsfreeze -u "$M" || exit 1
echo 'thaw-link=ok writer=completed probe=unfrozen'
cd /tmp/parity-case || exit 99
/usr/bin/umount "$M" || exit 98
mounted=0
/usr/sbin/losetup -d "$dev" || exit 98
for ((i=0;i<50;i++)); do [[ -e /sys/block/${dev#/dev/}/loop/backing_file ]] || break; /usr/bin/sleep 0.1; done
[[ ! -e /sys/block/${dev#/dev/}/loop/backing_file ]] || exit 98
dev=
echo 'teardown=ok'
